agencyCheck.cardUnconfirmed: {agency} found this diver, but not this certification.

agencyCheck.juniorUnder15: {agency} shows a Junior card. Under 15, record it by hand.

agencyCheck.noRecord: {agency} has no match for this {identity, select, card_number {card number} birth_date {name and birth date} other {name}}.
agencyCheck.noRecordCmas: The CMAS portal doesn’t list this certification. Federations are still adding theirs, so ask the federation named on the card.
agencyCheck.severalRecords: {agency} lists more than one diver by this name.
agencyCheck.captcha: {agency} is asking if you’re human. Check on its page.
agencyCheck.pageChanged: {agency}’s page has changed. Check on its page.
agencyCheck.unsupported: This copy of the extension doesn’t check {agency}. Update it.
agencyCheck.notFoundOnPage: Couldn’t find {name} on {agency}’s page. Open it and look.
agencyCheck.noAnswer: DiveDay didn’t answer. Reload to see where this certification stands.
agencyCheck.signedOut: Sign in to the PADI Pros’ Site first, then check again.

listed.leadFor: {agency} also shows these certifications for {name}. Add them? Each waits for Mark certified.
listed.failed: Couldn’t add them. Reload to see this diver’s certifications.

certifications.sightCardHint: The diver told us this level. Enter the agency and number from the certification record you verified.
certifications.sightNitroxCardHint: The diver told us they’re nitrox certified. RAID and GUE cover enriched air in the level credential (RAID Open Water 20 or Advanced 35, GUE Fundamentals or Rec 1), so record that one. Every other agency issues a separate enriched-air credential, and a level credential from them is not nitrox evidence.
certifications.sightCardLevelHint: Prefilled with what the diver said. Change it to match the certification record you verified.
certifications.cardNumberShapeHint: The number recorded in the certification record: at least three characters, including a digit.
certifications.clearNoCertificationHint: Someone said on a public form that this diver has no certification. Anyone who knows their name and email can leave that answer, so clear it if they didn’t. Clearing says nothing about certification, never that they’re certified, and the deal and wait lists stop flagging them.
certifications.noCertificationClearedNote: A “not certified yet” answer was cleared from this record by {name} on {date}.
certifications.noCertificationRestated: Staff cleared this answer once before and it has been given again on a public form since. Anyone who knows this diver’s name and email can leave it.

tripNeeds.card: A certification card. None on file.

page.noticeRestoreRefused: Couldn’t restore that diver, because an active diver now uses their email. Change that email, then try again.
page.noticeErased: Personal data erased. The signed release, the trips, and the payments stay on file with the diver’s details gone. This cannot be undone.
page.noticeErasedProcessorOwed: Personal data erased here, but something at Stripe isn’t finished. Open Settings to see what’s left and clear it. Until then this diver isn’t fully erased.
page.noticeNotAuthorized: Deleting or restoring a diver is limited to owners and managers.
page.noticeInvalid: Check the diver’s name, email, and phone number.
page.newDiverLead: A name is enough to start. Add contact details when you have them.

page.partyOnFile: Some names here read like people already on file. Choose for each one.

party.dobHint: Optional. It sets a junior diver’s depth limit.

bookActivity.noEmailNote: No email on file. Hand this diver their waiver link in person, or add an address to their record.

remove.consequence: Takes {name} off the roster, the booking pickers, manifests, and trip prep. Their waivers, trips, and payments stay on file, and you can restore them.
remove.staffWarning: They also work here. Deleting them takes them off the team, and they can no longer sign in.

removed.heading: This diver is deleted
removed.body: Out of the roster, booking pickers, manifests, and trip prep. Their records stay on file.
removed.restoreRestricted: Only owners and managers can restore a diver.

merge.heading: Possible duplicate records
merge.sameNameAndBirthDate: Same name and date of birth

mergePreview.title: Merge duplicate records
mergePreview.recordDetail: Added {date}, {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}}
mergePreview.chooseHint: Where the two disagree, choose the one to keep.
mergePreview.movesHeading: What moves to the kept record
mergePreview.bookingConflict: Both records hold a seat on the same departure, which usually means two people. If they really are one diver, cancel the extra seat or move it to another departure first.
mergePreview.keptSeatCancelled: The kept record’s seat on this departure is canceled and the other record’s isn’t. Keep the other record instead.
mergePreview.birthDateMinorHint: The date you keep decides which releases need a parent or guardian’s signature.
mergePreview.openMedicalHold: A medical answer on this record still needs a physician’s sign-off.
mergePreview.declinedClearance: A physician declined to clear a medical answer on this record.
mergePreview.differentBirthDates: The two records have different dates of birth.
mergePreview.birthDateUnknownOnOneRecord: Only one record has a date of birth, and only the name matches. A parent and child can share a name.
mergePreview.bothHoldCardsOrReleases: Both records hold certifications or signed releases. If these are two people, one person’s cards and releases end up on the other’s record.
mergePreview.releasesUnderDifferentNames: Signed releases are on file, and these names do not all match: {names}. Every release moves to the kept record.
mergePreview.medicalAnswerWaiting: A medical answer is still waiting on a physician. If these are two people, a newer release on the other record would stand in for it.
mergePreview.medicalAnswerDeclined: A physician declined to clear a medical answer. If these are two people, a newer release on the other record would stand in for it.
mergePreview.acknowledge: I confirmed with the diver (or their ID) that these records are one person.
mergePreview.confirm: Merge {source} into {kept}? {source}’s record is deleted and everything on it moves to {kept}.

erase.heading: Erase personal data
erase.description: Destroys this diver’s details for good. Not the same as deleting them.
erase.destroyedNote: Destroyed: name, email, phone, date of birth, emergency contact, insurance, certification numbers and evidence photos, medical answers, rental sizes, staff notes, review comments, and any photos they shared.
erase.keptNote: Kept, with their name gone from all of it: that they signed your release, which version, and when, plus the trips they were on and what was paid. Signed releases stay verifiable.

guardianEmail.heading: Guardian’s email
guardianEmail.description: A parent or guardian who co-signed this diver’s release can ask for their email to be erased. Their name and signature stay on the release, and the release is marked as redacted.
guardianEmail.confirmHint: Erased from every release this guardian co-signed here, and it cannot be undone.

rentalFit.heading: Rental fit
rentalFit.description: What the trip prep list is built from. It is never a reservation, and never a substitute for a dock-side fit check.
rentalFit.changeRestricted: Changing what this diver asked for is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters.
rentalFit.drysuitSizeHint: Most rental drysuits have the boots vulcanized on, so this size answers for the feet too and the packing list carries no boots line. If yours take separate rock boots, put that size in here as well; it is the only field on the fit the packer will see.
rentalFit.flaggedBody: They still count on the prep list, but without a size, so the crew fits them from what’s aboard.
rentalFit.fitResolved: Fit resolved — pack their sizes again
rentalFit.clearingRestricted: Clearing this is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters, who confirm the diver can be packed to their stated sizes again.

history.importedVisitsText: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} came across from your previous system. Those lines are booking records, not dive records.

notices.drysuitExperienceRecorded: Recorded. The roster stops reminding you about a drysuit card for this diver. No card was added.
notices.drysuitExperienceCleared: Cleared. The roster reminds you about a drysuit card for this diver again.
notices.drysuitExperienceUnchanged: Nothing changed. The record already said that.
notices.drysuitExperienceNotAuthorized: Only an instructor, assistant instructor, divemaster, manager or owner can record seeing someone dive dry. Clearing it is for whoever recorded it, a manager or the owner.
notices.drysuitExperienceNoteRequired: Not recorded. Say briefly what you saw, in 200 characters or fewer.
notices.drysuitExperienceNotRecordable: Not recorded. This is only for someone else who dives dry with no drysuit card on file. A card on file is confirmed instead.
notices.alreadyBooked: This diver is already booked on that activity.
notices.booked: Booked. Review it below, then create and send the invoice.
notices.bookedConfirmed: Booked, and their confirmation is on its way. Review it below, then create and send the invoice.
notices.bookedConfirmedNoInvoice: Booked, and their confirmation is on its way.
notices.bookedWaiverUndelivered: Booked, but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Open the trip’s Divers tab to send it or share the link.
notices.bookedIdentityUnconfirmed: Booked, but the seat is held until you confirm it’s the same person. Open the trip’s Divers tab to confirm it.
notices.bookingInvalid: Add an email and choose a departure.
notices.cardNumberImplausible: That doesn’t look like a certification number. Type the number exactly as shown in the certification record, digits included.
notices.cardRestoreConflict: Couldn’t restore that certification, because another record now uses its number. Re-add it if you still need it.
notices.cardRestored: Certification restored. It counts toward readiness again.
notices.cardSightingRequired: This certification is only what the diver told us. Enter the agency and number from the certification record to verify it.
notices.cardUndoFailed: Couldn’t undo that. This certification has changed since.
notices.cleared: That was the last thing. Nothing is waiting on {name}.
notices.courseMinAge: This diver is under that course’s minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on file. Correct the date of birth if it’s wrong.
notices.coursePrerequisite: Mark the required certification as certified before booking this course.
notices.courseRatioFull: This session is at its instructor-to-student ratio limit. Assign another instructor, or choose another activity.
notices.courseUnstaffed: Assign an instructor before booking this course.
notices.dateOfBirthAgeUnstated: To clear the date of birth, select “They’re 18 or older”.
notices.dateOfBirthCourseMinimumAge: Keep the date of birth: they’re booked on a course with a minimum age.
notices.duplicate: Another diver already uses that email in this shop.
notices.duplicateCard: Another live certification at this shop already has that number. Check the number, or delete the certification that holds it.
notices.eraseNameMismatch: The name you typed doesn’t match this diver’s, so nothing was erased. Type it exactly as it appears above.
notices.eraseRefused: This record can’t be erased. Staff records keep the shop’s own accountability trail, and you can’t erase your own.
notices.eraseRequiresDelete: Not erased. Delete this diver first.
notices.fitCleared: Fit flag cleared. This diver packs from their stated sizes again.
notices.invalid: Check the details and try again.
notices.medicalClearanceDateInFuture: That evaluation date is in the future.
notices.medicalClearanceDateRequired: Give the date on the physician’s evaluation.
notices.medicalClearanceDateTooEarly: That letter is dated before the referral it would answer. It can stand only if it is dated on or after the diver’s first referral and within a year, covers every condition they disclosed, and you tick that the physician evaluated their current condition.
notices.medicalClearanceRecordedEarlierHeld: Recorded from the earlier letter. The diver’s other seat is still held by that earlier referral. Record the letter against it too.
notices.medicalClearanceDocumentFailed: That evaluation file couldn’t be stored.
notices.medicalClearanceEvidenceRequired: Name the physician, or attach their evaluation.
notices.medicalClearanceAnswerRecorded: A physician’s answer is already on this record. Seat them on a departure and send a new release from there.
notices.medicalClearanceNoHold: Nothing of this diver’s is waiting on medical review here.
notices.medicalClearanceRecorded: Physician clearance recorded. This diver is no longer held for medical review.
notices.medicalNotClearedRecorded: Recorded. The physician did not clear this diver, and the medical hold stands.
notices.mergeAlreadyMerged: One of these records has already been merged. Refresh the page and choose an active record.
notices.mergeAlreadyRemoved: One of these records is deleted. Restore it before merging.
notices.mergeAnonymized: These records cannot be merged because one has already been erased.
notices.mergeAssessmentChanged: Something on these records changed since you opened this comparison. Read it again before merging. Nothing was moved.
notices.mergeBookingConflict: Not merged: both records hold a seat on the same departure, which usually means two people.
notices.mergeBookingConflictOn: Not merged: both records hold a seat on {departure}, which usually means two people.
notices.mergeDepartureUnderway: One of these records is on a departure that is out now. Merge after the boat is back.
notices.mergeDifferentPeopleUnacknowledged: Not merged yet: confirm these records are the same person first.
notices.mergeInvalid: Choose one of the possible duplicate records and try again.
notices.mergeRecordConflict: Not merged: these records have conflicting history that cannot be combined safely.
notices.mergeStaffRecord: Staff or crew records cannot be merged with a diver record.
notices.merged: Diver records merged. The selected record is now the survivor.
notices.mergedRecordMoved: That record was merged into this one. Nothing was saved, so make the change here.
notices.noCertificationCleared: Cleared. This diver’s record no longer says anything about certification, and clearing never adds one.
notices.noCertificationNothingToClear: Nothing to clear. This diver’s record no longer says they have no certification.
notices.notAuthorizedCards: Your account can’t change certifications for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.notAuthorizedDelete: Deleting a diver is limited to owners and managers. Ask one of them to do it.
notices.removeCrewUpcoming: They are crew on a departure that is ahead or still out. Take them off it, or wait until the boat is home, then delete.
notices.notAuthorizedDetails: Your account can’t edit this diver for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.notAuthorizedErase: Erasing a diver’s personal data is limited to the shop owner. Ask them to do it.
notices.notAuthorizedFit: Changing a diver’s stated rental fit is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters. You can still flag them for hands-on fitting at check-in.
notices.notAuthorizedMerge: Merging diver records is limited to owners and managers. Ask one of them to do it.
notices.notAuthorizedNotes: Your account can’t change this diver’s notes for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.notAuthorizedWaiver: Your account can’t record a paper waiver for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.paymentNotConnected: Payments aren’t connected yet. Connect them to charge this diver.
notices.personSavedAdultAnswerUnused: Saved. A date of birth is on file, so “They’re 18 or older” wasn’t used.
notices.removedReadOnly: Restore this diver before changing their details.
notices.restoreRefused: Couldn’t restore this diver, because an active diver now uses their email. Change that email, then try again.
notices.tripFull: That activity just filled up. Choose another.
notices.tripPrerequisite: This diver’s certifications on file don’t reach what that trip and its dive sites require. Open the trip to see what it asks for.
notices.tripUnavailable: Add an email and choose an available activity.
notices.waiverError: That paper waiver couldn’t be recorded. Open the diver’s next departure to see why.
notices.waiverIdentityUnconfirmed: That seat is held until somebody confirms who the diver is, so a paper release can’t go on their record yet. Confirm it on the departure’s Divers tab, then record the release.
notices.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver, or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notices.waiverGuardianName: The co-signer’s name is the diver’s own, so this release would show one person signing twice. Type the guardian’s name as their own ID reads it, and if the diver’s record is shorter than the diver’s ID, correct the record to match. If the two really do read exactly alike, record the release at the check-in counter or from the trip roster, where you can confirm you watched both of them sign.
notices.waiverPaperRecorded: Paper waiver recorded, signed and on file
notices.guardianEmailErased: Guardian’s email erased from every release at this shop that carried it. Each one is marked as redacted.
notices.guardianEmailMismatch: The email you typed doesn’t match, so nothing was erased. Type it exactly as it appears above.
notices.guardianEmailNotFound: Nothing erased: that email is no longer on this diver’s releases.
notices.notAuthorizedGuardianEmail: Erasing a guardian’s email is limited to the shop owner. Ask them to do it.
notices.lastDiveInvalid: Enter the day they last dived.
notices.lastDiveSavedLaterKnown: Saved. They’ve dived with you since then, so the row shows that later day.
